[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Maishang Hills]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Maishang Hills in [[the Jade Sea]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 7,000 [[Luxon faction|Luxon Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear the Maishang Hills in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."''
